name: closing-call-to-action
purpose: The last ask at the end of a landing page, followed by a hatched closing frame with no rules of its own, because the site footer under it opens with one. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `call-to-action`, `button`, `frame-box` and `texture-material`. `kind` picks the layout only: `split` sets the headline and the primary action in a raised lead cell beside an aside cell carrying the description and the secondary action, over a tall closing frame; `panel` sets the copy and its actions on one surface, over a short closing frame; `primary` is the loud close, one centred ask on the canvas under a pixelated texture whose waves keep travelling, over a tall closing frame. All three take the same copy and the same two actions.
useWhen: To close a solution or product page on its one or two asks (`split`), or a page such as Careers on one action (`panel`), or a page that ends on its one loud ask (`primary`).
avoidWhen: For a newsletter sign-up close → use `closing-call-to-action-newsletter`.
For an ask in the middle of a page → compose `call-to-action` directly.
related: call-to-action` — the framed band this section renders.
closing-call-to-action-newsletter` — the closing band whose ask is a subscribe form.
bestPractices: Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer`, after a hatched `section-gap`.
Set `anchor: 'contact'` so the page's contact links scroll to the close.
In `split`, keep `title` and `titleMuted` to one short line each; `panel` and `primary` do not draw `titleMuted`, and `primary` does not draw `eyebrow`.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Layout of the band: `split` is a raised lead cell beside an aside cell over a tall closing frame, `panel` one surface over a short closing frame, `primary` a centred ask under a pixelated texture over a tall closing frame.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short overline above the headline; not drawn in `primary`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the call to action as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: titleMuted
props.doc: Second line of the headline in muted ink; drawn in `split` only.

props.name: description
props.doc: Supporting sentence: in the aside cell in `split`, under the headline in `panel`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The white button of the band, under the headline in `split`; `{ label, href, trailing? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: The outlined button of the band, in the aside cell in `split` and beside the primary one in `panel` and `primary`; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToAction from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action'

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Start for free',
    href: 'https://console.azion.com/signup?tck=build_cta'
  }

  const secondaryAction = {
    label: 'Talk to a specialist',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/contact/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <ClosingCallToAction
    kind="split"
    anchor="contact"
    eyebrow="Build"
    title="Build once."
    title-muted="Run everywhere."
    description="Get a faster path to launch, lower latency, and less infrastructure overhead."
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
    :secondary-action="secondaryAction"
  />
</template>
